title: CreateOutputRequest
description: Body of `POST /api/pipelines/:id/outputs`. `nodeStepId` and `rootId` are mutually exclusive (HEL-913): a step id targets that step's tail projection; `rootId` targets a specific pipeline root (naming WHICH root when the Output is root-bound, since a pipeline may have more than one). Both absent keeps the pre-multi-root convention of binding to the pipeline's (only) root.

config.description: Output config. `compare` (HEL-1273) selects the history comparison: absent/null (none), `previous_run`, `1d`, `7d`, `30d`, or `custom:<d>` where <d> is a positive ISO-8601 duration in days/hours/minutes/seconds (PnDTnHnMnS, at most 365 days; week/month/year and lowercase/signed forms are rejected). Anything else is a 400. `historyPayloads` (HEL-1276) opts this Output's node into storing each real run's full row payload (boolean, default off; absent/null/false store none): kept only for beta (10 runs / 7 days) and owner (30 runs / 30 days) pipeline owners, never for free, and a node over 1000 rows or 1 MiB stores none. Any non-boolean is a 400. Known top-level `config` keys per kind (HEL-1313; every other key is a 400 naming it, with a did-you-mean hint): every kind - `fieldMapping`, `compare`, `historyPayloads`; chart - `chartType`, `aggregation`, `chartOptions`, `annotation`; metric - `aggregation`, `label`, `unit`, `format`; table - `columnOrder`, `columnFormats`, `columnSort`, `columnFilters`, `pinnedColumns`; collection - `layout`, `format`; timeline - `sort`; markdown - `content`. A key already stored on the Output (a legacy key such as `metricLabel`) may be re-sent with its stored value unchanged, or cleared with null; introducing or changing any other unknown key is rejected, so `additionalProperties` is deliberately not false here. `aggregation` is null, `{groupBy, agg, yField}` on a chart (never on a scatter chart), or `{agg}` (field from `fieldMapping.value`) / `{value, agg}` on a metric; `agg` is count|sum|avg|min|max and every named field a non-empty string; any other kind or shape is a 400. `chartType` is bar|line|pie|scatter or null.

fieldMapping.description: Slot name -> column name; slot names are validated per kind.

aggregation.description: Chart or metric kind only; null clears it.
